independent_run.environment: model/database env removed; plugin autoload disabled; bytecode/cache writing disabled

findings.finding: No regression found in the synthetic script-copy fix. Exact production script bytes execute in a real Python subprocess, without patching product collect/config/dependency behavior. ROOT remains derived from __file__; the synthetic repository deliberately lacks its own selected .venv, so the preserved BLOCKED assertion is valid regardless of whether the calling interpreter is the actual checkout .venv.

Production scripts/install_preflight.py and src/sim2act/preflight.py are unchanged vs baseline. The script-copy and scripts directory creation occur before the no-write inventory capture, isolating fixture preparation from observed CLI execution.

Existing no-write assertions check selected config bytes and top-level repository names, not recursive filesystem integrity; redaction checks one synthetic sentinel in stdout/stderr. These inherited coverage limits are not strengthened by this fix and cannot prove absence of every possible side effect or disclosure.

The real-CLI test uses an absolute selected config and other tests cover collect with an alternate repo-relative config. Static script review confirms reads only config_path derived from explicit --config and does not consult ambient configuration, write files, start subprocesses, connect databases or networks. The copied standalone script does not test a full installed product start or native Windows launch.

Existing 105-case evidence verified independently by JUnit parsing, unchanged node multiset, manifests and current/source equality, but no independent rerun of all 105 cases and no SQLite before/after source snapshot exist.
No conclusions about PostgreSQL cold connection behavior, lease cancellation race, Windows 900/240/150-second qualification or complete candidate PG pass follow from this review.

cleanup: unittest TemporaryDirectory fixtures self-cleaned; reviewer log/JUnit/receipts remain in own /tmp artifact directory; no PG/Docker resource created
